header.title: Skills
header.description: Skills gate who can be asked or booked. Productions require them per part; artists hold them on their profile.

row.blockedTooltipProductions: In use by {{count}} productions, archive it instead
row.blockedTooltipDates: Required by upcoming dates, archive it instead
row.safeToDeleteTooltip: Not required by any production, safe to delete

footerNote: Archiving hides a skill from every picker and keeps it on the artists who hold it. Deleting is only offered while no production requires it. New workspaces are seeded from the platform starter list.

newDialog.title: New skill
newDialog.description: Skills are shared across the organization's productions and artist profiles.

renameDialog.title: Rename {{name}}
renameDialog.description: This name is shown everywhere the skill appears.

toast.collisionArchived: A skill named "{{name}}" is archived. Use Restore to bring it back.
toast.collisionMaybeArchived: A skill named "{{name}}" already exists. It may be archived: check Settings > Skills.
